jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.description: Build and maintain mobile applications using Kotlin, React Native, and modern Android technologies.
jobs.fullDescription: We are looking for an Android Developer to join our team at truID. This role is ideal for developers with 1–2 years of experience who are eager to work on cutting-edge Android applications involving SDK development, AI integrations, and modern frameworks. If you're passionate about mobile development and want to grow in a dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!
responsibilities: Develop Android Applications: Build and maintain mobile applications using Kotlin, React Native, and modern Android technologies.
SDK Development: Assist in creating and optimizing Android SDKs for biometric and AI-powered applications.
Jetpack Compose: Work with Jetpack Compose to design and implement intuitive UI components.
TensorFlow Model Inference: Implement and integrate AI/ML models using TensorFlow Lite.
CameraX Integration: Utilize CameraX API for real-time image processing and scanning.
Collaboration: Work closely with senior developers, UI/UX designers, and product teams.
Performance Optimization: Ensure smooth app performance by optimizing resource usage.
Testing and Debugging: Identify and troubleshoot issues through testing and debugging.
requirements: 1–2 years of experience in Android development.
Proficiency in Kotlin and familiarity with Android development frameworks (Jetpack, MVVM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, CameraX API, and React Native.
Understanding of TensorFlow Lite (preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of RESTful APIs and third-party integrations.
Experience with Git version control.
Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn.
idealCandidate: Developers with 1–2 years of Android development experience.
Candidates with exposure to React Native and a willingness to learn AI/ML integrations.
Enthusiastic individuals who enjoy problem-solving and working on innovative mobile solutions.
benefits: Work on cutting-edge AI-powered mobile applications.
Mentorship and career development from experienced developers.
Hands-on experience in SDK development and AI-driven technologies.
jobs.applyInstructions: Send your resume and a brief cover letter to careers@truid.ai with the subject line 'Android Developer Application'.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Build scalable, high-performance applications using FastAPI, Django, Vue.js, and React.js.
jobs.fullDescription: We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with expertise in Python-based back-end frameworks and modern front-end technologies. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of building scalable, high-performance applications using FastAPI, Django, Vue.js, and React.js.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs using FastAPI and Django.
Build interactive, responsive front-end applications with Vue.js and React.js.
Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and security.
Implement and maintain database schemas and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL).
Perform code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Deploy and manage applications in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) or using Docker/Kubernetes.
Stay up to date with the latest frameworks, tools, and best practices.
requirements: 2+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer.
Strong proficiency in Python with FastAPI and Django frameworks.
Hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, including Vue.js and React.js.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and WebSockets.
Proficiency with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Redis.
Experience with containerization and deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
Familiarity with Git/GitHub/GitLab version control.
Knowledge of testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
Solid understanding of software design principles and architecture patterns.
idealCandidate: Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team.
Attention to detail with a commitment to producing high-quality work.
Experience with microservices architecture is a plus.
Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) preferred.
Knowledge of security best practices in web application development.
jobs.applyInstructions: Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and portfolio to careers@truid.ai with 'Full Stack Developer' in the subject line.

jobs.title: Research Assistant – Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description: Design and implement computer vision algorithms, develop prototypes for AI solutions.
jobs.fullDescription: We are seeking a motivated Research Assistant – Computer Vision Engineer to join our R&D department. In this role, you will focus on designing and implementing computer vision algorithms, developing prototypes, and supporting the team in building AI solutions for real-world applications. This position is also well-suited for current Master's students looking to gain hands-on research and development experience alongside their studies.
responsibilities: Design, implement, and evaluate computer vision algorithms for tasks such as detection, tracking, segmentation, and recognition.
Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept systems to validate ideas.
Optimize models for accuracy, robustness, and inference speed.
Collaborate with engineers and researchers to integrate solutions into larger systems.
Document code, experiments, and results in a clear and reproducible manner.
requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
Open to current Master's students with relevant coursework and research interest.
Solid understanding of computer vision and deep learning concepts.
Proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Familiarity with supporting frameworks such as OpenCV, scikit-learn, ONNX, or TFLite.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
idealCandidate: Experience optimizing models for real-time or mobile deployment.
Knowledge of C++/CUDA for performance acceleration.
Exposure to model compression and optimization techniques (quantization, pruning, etc.).
benefits: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge computer vision applications.
Access to modern tools, frameworks, and infrastructure.
A collaborative and supportive environment with growth opportunities.
Potential transition into a full-time engineer role in R&D.
jobs.applyInstructions: Send your CV, academic transcripts, and a brief statement of research interest to careers@truid.ai with 'Research Assistant – Computer Vision' in the subject.
